question: What share of the public ntoskrnl and HAL names return the same status from the Windows 10 22H2 kernel and the VerOS kernel?
allowedInputs: compat/reference/win10-22h2-ntoskrnl.txt and compat/reference/win10-22h2-hal.txt are the probe output. There is no separate public page for that generated list.

measuredEffect.metric: kernel ABI percent from exact status agreement on the paired kernel probe
measuredEffect.note: 100 was 10 plugin returns divided by those 10 calls. 24.2 is 15 exact matches out of 62 reference names. ZwCreateFile disagreed, and 46 names were not called.
